defaultCommand.description: Defaults to whichever has hotkey number 1 (or if no hotkeys, the first one it finds)

startMinimised.description: Whether to start hidden or not.

inputFontSize.description: Size of input font in rem.

alwaysOnTop.description: Always on top of other windows?

globalShortcut.description: Global shortcut to toggle window visibility (e.g., Alt+Space, Option+Space, Cmd+Space). Defaults: Windows=Alt+Space, macOS=Option+Space, Linux=Alt+Space

hideOnLostFocus.description: Whether clicking outside the app will cause it to hide.
